facts.name: vt_AEndFieldActionOneShotAccessActor
facts.note: The pass TOWER: the class's native vtable (referenced by OneShotAccess_Ctor in both exes); its actor slots from +0x338 up sit +8 from 1.004.

facts.name: slot: OneShotAccess register (1.004 vt+0x720, 1.005 vt+0x728)
facts.note: Holds OneShotAccess register (below) in both exes. Called by End2FieldActionActor_OnTriggerEnter (1.004 0x1409DC534 via vt+0x720, 1.005 0x140D813D0 via vt+0x728), which ignores the return value.

facts.name: OneShotAccess_Vt720_RegisterWithLeaderPC_StoreLeader8B0
facts.note: (actor): ResolvePartyLeaderWeakPtr; only when it is non-null AND IsEndPlayerCharacter: +0x8B0 = the leader, register on the leader's PC+0x618 list, arm the tick. No meaningful return (al is whatever the last call left; the enter caller ignores it). 1.004 bytes 48895c2408488974241057b820000000.

facts.note: (actor): 1) the party leader (not +0x8B0), unregistered from its PC+0x618 list only if a player character; 2) setter(actor, 0, 0) always; 3) +0x8B0 = a null weak (8 bytes). 1.004 bytes 48895c241057b820000000e880e3a0fe.

facts.name: vt_OneShotAccessExecuter
facts.note: Written by OneShotAccessExecuter_Ctor (1.004 0x1436912DC, 1.005 0x1433C8C4C). Executer weaks: +0x8 actor and +0x10 character (base executer ctor, from the create call's arguments), +0x58 actor (setup copies +0x8 there after an IsA OneShotAccess test); same offsets in both.

facts.name: slot: OneShotAccessExecuter tick (+0x20)
facts.note: Holds FieldActionExecuter_Tick_Vt20_CallsVt80 (below). That function sits at +0x20 of three other executer vtables too (1.004 0x1466FA4B0 unnamed, vt_LiftingRopeExecuter 0x1466FF510, vt_OneShotMoveExecuter 0x146706C40; 1.005 0x1465880E0, 0x14658C040, 0x146594700): replace this slot only, never the function.

facts.name: FieldActionExecuter_Tick_Vt20_CallsVt80
facts.note: (executer, dt in xmm1): actor weak +0x58 valid -> call vt+0x80 (the tower's phase update, 1.004 0x1436BF4D0, 1.005 0x1433F6DA8); else request end. Shared by 4 executer vtables. 1.004 bytes 4053b830000000e854c7a2fe482be048.

facts.name: OneShotAccess_SetFieldActionMgrPoint
facts.note: (actor rcx, show dl, notUsable r8b), 3 arguments. First instruction mov [rsp+10h],rbx (48 89 5C 24 10, 5 bytes, no RIP-relative operand); entry %16 = 0 (1.004) / 8 (1.005), so it lies inside one 16-byte block in both. On a change of show (+0x8E1): listener added or removed, +0x8E0 = 0, the point added or removed by Tags[0]. While shown, every call: point +0x104 bit 0x08 = notUsable; bit 0x10 when done or +0x8E0. 1.004 bytes identical.

facts.name: OneShotAccess_Tick's setter call (the point-off request +0x8E2)
facts.note: E8 to the setter, (0, 0). The actor's own off (executer End set +0x8E2).

facts.name: OneShotAccess_EndPlay_PointOff's setter call
facts.note: E8 to the setter, (0, 0). The actor's own off, unconditional, leaving play.

facts.name: OneShotAccess_PointOff_StartWakeTimer8F0's setter call
facts.note: E8 to the setter, (0, 0). The actor's own off: only from OneShotAccessExecuter_MarkComplete8D1_OrWakeAction (1.004 0x1436B3E08, 1.005 0x1433EB6F4) when CompleteWakeAction +0x868 is set; towers set none, so never on a tower.

facts.name: OneShotAccess unregister's setter call
facts.note: E8 to the setter, (0, 0). The leave of whoever the trigger-leave delivery runs for (reads the leader); a player's leave, not the actor's own.

facts.name: OneShotAccess_DecidePointShow_From8B0's setter call A (entry block)
facts.note: E8 to the setter. Off (0, 0) when +0x8B0 is invalid, the actor not available (vt+0x668 / +0x670), the hub row done, or the state +0x8DC not 1/3/4; ALSO show=1 notUsable=0 when the state is 3/4 and not done. The decide runs from the notify (per holder) and from UpdateState on every actor tick and at BeginPlay: this return address alone does not tell a player's call from the actor's own.

facts.name: OneShotAccess_DecidePointShow_From8B0's setter call B (wake timer)
facts.note: E8 to the setter, (0, 0), in the decide's tail chunk: off while the wake timer +0x8F0 runs (only after a wake action; towers never arm it). Same callers as call A.

facts.name: OneShotAccess_DecidePointShow_From8B0's setter call C (state 1 show)
facts.note: E8 to the setter, (1, +0x8E3), then +0x8E3 = 0. Same callers as call A.

facts.name: OneShotAccess notify's decide call
facts.note: E8 to the decide inside the notify: a holder's decide (a player's view).

facts.name: OneShotAccess_UpdateState8DC_PlayIdleAnims's decide call
facts.note: E8 to the decide at UpdateState's end, reached on every call (state changed or not); UpdateState runs from the actor tick and BeginPlay (1.004 UpdateState 0x141445394, 1.005 0x1412FBC24). The actor's own decide.

facts.name: offset: bTower (u8 bool)
facts.note: Reflection dump BoolProperty EndFieldActionOneShotAccessActor:bTower [o: 8A0]; the ctor writes a whole byte, TowerApproachTransform tests cmp byte [actor+8A0h],0 (1.004 0x1436B3FD5, 1.005 0x1433EB8C1).

facts.name: offset: in-range weak (FWeakObjectPtr, 8 bytes)
facts.note: Written only by the ctor (0), the register (AssignObject) and the unregister (8-byte null copy); read by the decide (IsValid).

facts.name: offset: press latch (u8)
facts.note: Set 1 by the key listener; cleared by the setter on a show change and by executer End; read by the progress and the setter's bit 0x10.

facts.name: offset: point shown (u8)
facts.note: Only the setter reads and writes it.

facts.name: offset: cannot act (u8)
facts.note: Written by the notify; read and cleared by the decide's call C.

facts.name: offset: completed (u8)
facts.note: Set by the executer's MarkComplete; consumed by the actor tick.
